methodology.signal: X02 LIMIT_ADJUSTED_MOMENTUM fixed on T-1 close
methodology.entry: T 14:45 5m bar close; this avoids using the 14:45 bar open when bars are end-labelled
methodology.execution_filter: non-ST/trading, valid 14:45 volume+amount, not at upper limit, configurable limit buffer
methodology.market_gate: NOT_WEAK uses the existing frozen weak_market flag from T-1 only
methodology.intraday_confirmation: for CONFIRM_COMBO, T price at 14:45 > day open and 14:45 > 14:30; all known at entry
methodology.ranking: SIGNAL=clean momentum rank; CONFIRM_COMBO=equal-weight percentile ranks of clean momentum, day return, final-15m return
methodology.portfolio: equal-weight Top-N; require at least N executable names or stay in cash
methodology.exit: next session first-bar open or 5m bar close at requested time
